programme.desc: When a water main bursts in the middle of the night at the historic St. Agatha's church cemetery, leaving the grounds littered with coffins, Brennan is called in to identify and help re-inter the remains. Though the last burial took place over 50 years ago, Brennan finds a skull buried less than five years ago.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Monsuno
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Elaine Palacio, la única modelo colombiana en portadas de Vogue Italia y ángel de Victoria's Secret, nació en Puerto Boyacá enfrentando racismo y baja autoestima. A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.

A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.
